# Andrew Ng

DeepLearning.AI, AI Fund and AI Aspire

Palo Alto, California, United States (US)

500 connections • 2,602,119 followers

## About

Andrew Yan-Tak Ng (Chinese: 吳恩達; born April 18, 1976) is a British-American computer scientist and technology entrepreneur focusing on machine learning and artificial intelligence(AI). Ng was a cofounder and head of Google Brain and was the former Chief Scientist at Baidu.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Born | Andrew Yan-Tak Ng, (1976-04-18) April 18, 1976 (age 50), London, England |
| Known for | His work in artificial intelligence, deep learning, MOOC, and education technology |
| Spouse | Carol E. Reiley, ​(m. 2014)​ |
| Children | 2 |
| Mother | Tisa Ho |
| Fields | Computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision |
| Workplaces | Stanford University, Google Brain, Coursera, Baidu |
| Thesis | Shaping and policy search in Reinforcement learning (2003) |
| Doctoral advisor | Michael I. Jordan |
| Notable students | Ian Goodfellow, David Stavens, Pieter Abbeel, Quoc Viet Le, Ashutosh Saxena |
| Website | andrewng.org |

## Experience

### Founder - [DeepLearning.AI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/deeplearningai) (Current)

Jun 2017 - Present (9 years and 2 months) in Palo Alto, California, United States

DeepLearning.AI provides technical training on Generative AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and other topics. We also offer a widely read newsletter, The Batch (thebatch.ai), that covers what matters in AI right now. Our courses are often created with industry-leading AI companies (AWS, Google, OpenAI, etc.), and we offer both short courses that can be completed in an hour, and longer courses and specializations hosted on Coursera that give you a solid foundation in some aspect of AI. These courses are designed to offer hands-on practice with AI technologies, and you will gain practical, job-ready skills. Whether you are just starting out in AI or seeking to further an existing career, come see if we can help, at http://deeplearning.ai! Show less

Department: General Management • Level: Founder

DeepLearning.AI is a Software Development company. DeepLearning.AI is an online platform that allows individuals to learn how to use and build AI through their courses. They offer certifications, level up skills, and stay ahead of the industry. DeepLearning.AI has 200-300 employees, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States, with an office in Palo Alto. Its workforce is distributed across 51 countries (including United States, India, Pakistan, Taiwan, and United Kingdom).

### Managing General Partner - [AI Fund](https://www.linkedin.com/company/aifund) (Current)

Jan 2018 - Present (8 years and 7 months)

AI Fund is a venture studio that partners with entrepreneurs to build AI companies that move humanity forward. We don't just provide capital, we actively help build the company: we seek to play at least a minor co-founder role in the companies we engage in. After identifying a concrete startup idea, we actively help the founder validate both customer need and technical feasibility (often collaborating to build a technical prototype), help shape the AI technology roadmap, the go-to-market, and help recruit the key leaders, including the AI engineering team. Because AI is a general purpose technology that can be applied to numerous sectors -- including ones that we at AI Fund don't have expertise in -- we partner with subject matter experts (SMEs) in logistics, healthcare, education, relationships, finance, and other sectors. By leveraging our AI expertise and the SME's expertise in an important application sector, we can build a promising AI business in that sector. We take responsible AI seriously and will, on ethical grounds, choose not to pursue projects that we otherwise assess to be financially sound. Show less

Department: General Management • Level: Partner

AI Fund is a Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals company. AI Fund is a venture studio that collaborates with entrepreneurs, venture funds, and corporate partners to create great companies that move humanity forward. AI Fund has 50-60 employees and has annual revenue in the $1M-$10M range, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States, with offices in Medellin and Palo Alto. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Taiwan, Colombia, China, and Ghana).

### Executive Chairman - [LandingAI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/landing-ai) (Current)

Oct 2017 - Present (8 years and 10 months) in Palo Alto, California

LandingAI delivers Document Intelligence via Agentic Document Extraction and other solutions. Enabled by the transformer neural network (created by the Google Brain team), the Generative AI revolution has arrived in text processing. We see a similar a revolution coming in visual data processing. LandingAI is developing cutting-edge technologies to help customers process visual data in numerous sectors, focusing on Document AI.

Department: General Management • Level: C-Level

LandingAI is a Software Development company. Landingai is a leading AI software company that offers cutting-edge computer vision platform technology. LandingAI has 40-50 employees (+6-7% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $10M-$20M range, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States, with an office in Palo Alto. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including United States, Colombia, China, Canada, and Bolivia). Has $57M in total funding, with 7 prior funding rounds.

### Co-Founder and Chairman - [Coursera](https://www.linkedin.com/company/coursera) (Current)

Jan 2012 - Present (14 years and 7 months) in Mountain View, CA

Coursera (NYSE: COUR) envisions a world where anyone, anywhere has the power to transform their lives through learning. Coursera had started with my Machine Learning class and a nascent online education product I had built at Stanford. I served as the company's Co-CEO in the early years with day-to-day responsibility for product, engineering, sales, marketing and operations, and remain Chairman of the company today. Coursera now has over 100M learners, and we partner with more than 275 leading universities and companies to bring flexible, affordable, job-relevant online learning to individuals and organizations. Coursera's offerings include courses, specializations, job-ready professional certificates and degree programs. http://coursera.org Show less

Department: General Management • Level: Founder

Coursera (COUR) is a E-Learning Providers company. Coursera is a company that provides affordable, job-relevant education to every corner of the world. They offer a wide range of job opportunities and have a commitment to enabling flexibility and work space choices for employees. Coursera values learners and strives to champion the needs, potential, and progress of learners everywhere. They prioritize teamwork, growth, and diversity. Coursera values respect, courage, and candor, and celebrates the. Coursera has 3,000-4,000 employees (+10% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $700M-$800M range. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States, with presence in United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across 105 countries (including United States, India, Canada, Egypt, and United Kingdom). IPO 2021.

### Adjunct Professor of Computer Science - [Stanford University](https://www.linkedin.com/school/stanford-university) (Current)

Sep 2002 - Present (23 years and 11 months)

I was the Director of the Stanford AI Lab (https://ai.stanford.edu/), home to 20+ faculty members and research groups, and a tenured professor in Stanford's Computer Science department. More recently, I switched to an Adjunct Professor role. My research group's work focused on AI, Deep Learning, Machine Learning and Robotics. Notable projects include early work in Deep Learning (that led to the founding of Google Brain), early work in online education (that led to the founding of Coursera), ROS (a widely used open-source robotics development platform), and work on Reinforcement Learning for robotic control (such as the Stanford autonomous helicopter). More recent efforts include applications of AI to Healthcare and to Climate Change. Show less

Department: Education • Level: Specialist

Stanford University is a higher education institution. Stanford University is a company that focuses on discovery and learning. Stanford University has 10,000-20,000 employees (+3-4% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $10B-$20B range, founded in 1885. Headquartered in Stanford, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 101 countries (including United States, India, United Kingdom, China, and Germany). Has $17.5M in total funding, with 12 prior funding rounds. Research output of 400,000-500,000 works, primarily in Medicine, Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology, and Engineering. Funds research behind 300-400 works.

### Member of Board Of Directors - [drive.ai](https://www.linkedin.com/company/drive.ai)

Jun 2017 - Jun 2019 (2 years) in Mountain View CA

Drive.ai built and operated a fleet of self-driving cars, and was successfully acquired by Apple.

Department: General Management • Level: Director

drive.ai is a Software Development company. Drive.ai has 1-10 employees (3-4% YoY decline) and has annual revenue in the $1M-$10M range, founded in 2015. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, China, and Namibia. Has $77M in total funding, with 4 prior funding rounds.

### Chief Scientist & VP - [Baidu, Inc.](https://www.linkedin.com/company/baidu-inc)

May 2014 - Apr 2017 (2 years and 11 months) in Sunnyvale, CA

I led Baidu's AI Group, a 1,300 person team including 300 in Baidu Research, and was responsible for the company's AI technology and strategy. My team built Baidu up to be China's leading AI company of its time. The AI Group delivered dozens of AI projects that significantly improved Baidu search, advertising, maps, delivery logistics, voice search, security, consumer finance and many more. I was also responsible for initiating and launching new AI-powered businesses, such as DuerOS (a very successful conversational computer platform), Autonomous Driving (now Apollo), and others. Other major products that I was responsible for included Image Search and the Baidu keyboard (with over 100M MAU). Show less

Department: Research • Level: President/Vice President

Baidu, Inc. (BIDU) is a Software Development company. Baidu, Inc. has 8,000-9,000 employees (+1-2% YoY) and has annual revenue in the CNY100B-CNY200B range, founded in 2000. Headquartered in Beijing, China, with an office in haidian. Its workforce is distributed across 33 countries (including China, United States, Hong Kong, United Kingdom, and Singapore). with 7 prior funding rounds.

### Founder and Lead, Google Brain (Deep Learning) project - [Google](https://www.linkedin.com/company/google)

Jan 2011 - Dec 2012 (1 year and 11 months) in Mountain View, CA

I started and led the Google Brain team, which helped Google transform into a modern AI company by developing advanced Deep Learning technology, and moving the company to adopt it for numerous business applications. The Google Brain team's success was the inspiration for many other companies to build up their own AI teams. Using Google's compute infrastructure, we started by proving that scaling up data and compute leads to huge performance improvements, and also created the famous "Google Cat" demonstration of AI learning to recognize objects (such as cats) by itself. Our technology for building large scale AI models was the pre-cursor to TensorFlow, and also allowed us to take deep learning to valuable Google products including ads, speech recognition, maps, and many others. http://www.nytimes.com/2012/06/26/technology/in-a-big-network-of-computers-evidence-of-machine-learning.html Show less

Google (GOOGL) is a Software Development company. Google is a technology company that offers a wide range of services and products to help businesses grow. They provide engineering jobs, artificial intelligence and machine learning, consumer hardware design and build systems, platforms and ecosystems, site reliability engineer, teams, engineering and tech, sales, service and support, and people. Google has 100,000-200,000 employees (1-2% YoY decline) and has annual revenue in the $300B-$400B range, founded in 1998. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States, operates in 17 countries (including Australia, Spain, France, Italy, and Switzerland). Its workforce is distributed across 201 countries (including United States, India, United Kingdom, Ireland, and Canada). Has a market cap in the $500B-$600B range. IPO 2004.

2003 - Present in Berkeley, California, United States

University of California, Berkeley is a higher education institution. UC Berkeley is a university that pushes the boundaries of knowledge, challenges convention, and expands opportunity to create the leaders of tomorrow. University of California, Berkeley has 10,000-20,000 employees (+3-4% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $2B-$3B range, founded in 1868. Headquartered in Berkeley, California, United States. Research output of 300,000-400,000 works, primarily in Physics and Astronomy, Engineering, and Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology. Funds research behind 200-300 works.

### Master of Science - MS, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at [Massachusetts Institute of Technology](https://www.linkedin.com/school/mit)

1998 - Present in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States

Massachusetts Institute of Technology is a higher education institution. MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology is a company that aims to advance knowledge and educate students in science, technology, and other areas of scholarship that will best serve the nation and the world in the 21st century. Massachusetts Institute of Technology has 10,000-20,000 employees (+3-4% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $5B-$6B range, founded in 1861. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 95 countries (including United States, India, United Kingdom, Canada, and Germany).

### Bachelor of Science - BS, Math/Computer Science, Statistics and Economics (triple major) at [Carnegie Mellon University](https://www.linkedin.com/school/carnegie-mellon-university)

1997 - Present in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States

Carnegie Mellon University is a higher education institution. Carnegie Mellon University is a private, global research university that stands among the world's top educational institutions with cutting-edge programs and innovations. Carnegie Mellon University has 6,000-7,000 employees (+1-2% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $1B-$2B range, founded in 1900. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States, with presence in Qatar. Its workforce is distributed across 52 countries (including United States, India, Rwanda, China, and Qatar). Research output of 100,000-200,000 works, primarily in Computer Science, Engineering, and Physics and Astronomy. Funds research behind 500-600 works.
